references.text:
Our families deserve a government that focuses on what matters, works across party lines, and delivers results. I’ll keep showing up, working hard, and fighting for the communities we call home. 

Glad to champion the following bills:

▪️ H.R. 309, National Law Enforcement Officers Remembrance, Support and Community Outreach Act, would support community outreach, public safety education, and officer wellness initiatives. Our law enforcement officers put themselves on the line for us, and we have a responsibility to stand behind them.

▪️ H.R. 979, AM Radio for Every Vehicle Act, would preserve access to AM radio in new vehicles. When hurricanes and severe storms knock out power or cell service, eastern North Carolinians need reliable access to emergency information.

▪️ H.R. 1266, Combating Illicit Xylazine Act, would strengthen law enforcement tools to combat the illicit use and trafficking of xylazine while preserving legitimate veterinary uses. We must keep dangerous drugs off our streets while protecting the farmers and veterinarians who rely on xylazine for legitimate purposes.
